correctness.rationale: By the source's Lemma 2.1 and Proposition 2.3 the domain is smooth irreducible, the map is defined everywhere and onto, and every parameter in a fiber is a multiple root of the nonzero binary form P_w. Nonvanishing follows from P_w(λ_j,1)=w_j²q′(λ_j) up to nonzero normalization. At any such parameter there is at most one vanishing multiplier; the other coordinates fix the projective scale and the zeroth moment fixes the square of the missing coordinate. This proves quasi-finiteness, hence finiteness by projectivity. In the proposed degree-one argument, p_x/q=Σ_j x_j²/(z−λ_j), so the four moments vanish exactly when deg p_x≤n−2. Degree-exact squarefree R of degree n−2 is realized by x_j²=R(λ_j)/q′(λ_j), and choosing the new double root distinct from the roots of R and the λ_j gives a nonempty open locus with a unique lift. Characteristic zero gives birationality and normality of the source identifies the normalization. For each m, taking the interpolation polynomial R=1 already gives an x with all coordinates nonzero; the sign flip at m gives two distinct lifts at [λ_m:1]. Thus W is not normal, and reduced Cartier in smooth X implies S₂, hence failure of R₁. Adjunction yields K_Z3=O(2), deg K_Z3=32 and genus 17. The saved rational kernel checks concern only six sample parameters in n=3; the proof is uniform and no fresh replay is claimed.
